t.zh: 「若…则…」的证明是函数，别的连接词的证明是数据。「A ∧ B」的证明是一对，写作 ⟨a, b⟩，p.1、p.2 取出它的两半。「A ∨ B」只有一边成立，证明带着标签：Or.inl a 是「左边，证明是 a」，Or.inr b 是「右边」；分情况写作 p.elim f g，按标签决定用 f 还是 g。
t.en: A proof of an “if … then …” is a function; the other connectives’ proofs are data. A proof of “A ∧ B” is a pair, written ⟨a, b⟩, and p.1 and p.2 take out its halves. In “A ∨ B” only one side holds, so its proof carries a tag: Or.inl a means “the left one, proved by a”, Or.inr b “the right one”; Cases is written p.elim f g, and the tag decides whether f or g is used.

t.zh: 否定不需要新东西：¬A 就是 A → ⊥。⊥ 没有证明，像一个没有值的类型；万一有了一个，False.elim 把它当作任何一句的证明。
t.en: Negation needs nothing new: ¬A is A → ⊥. ⊥ has no proof, like a type with no values; should one turn up, False.elim makes it a proof of any sentence.

after.zh: 证明板上的每条规则，不是造一种值，就是用一种值。
after.en: Every rule on the proof board either makes a kind of value or uses one.

hint.en: Or.inl and Or.inr put on the tags “left” and “right”; the two funs after p.elim are the two compartments of Cases.
